title: Tiny Tasks
summary: Make a big, vague task small enough to start.

cover.alt: Illustrative Tiny Tasks interface for this fictional project

screenshots.alt: Detail of the fictional Tiny Tasks workspace, labeled as a design preview

story.problem: An item like finish the project does not tell you what to do next.
story.built: A quiet planning board that turns a broad goal into a few editable next actions.
story.aiUse: Aider helped implement the interface. A model suggests task breakdowns that the user can rewrite.
story.humanDecisions: I kept the user in control of the plan, added an undo path, and tested that edits preserve task order.
story.limitations: Suggestions do not understand your real schedule. Dates and commitments always stay with the user.
